title: A股港股早报：存储和AI应用领涨，京东beat反跌考验平台承接 + 美股盘前：零售销售意外转弱，科技强于道指但AMAT遭负反馈
summary: 隔夜美股在PPI降温后继续偏强，Futunn Sparks显示存储概念、AI应用软件、WSB、以太坊储备和充电桩领涨；但JD.com业绩beat后ADR下跌、Cisco/Coherent等高预期科技股承压，A/H今日关注联想AI基建、京东平台承接、CPO/存储映射和高估值兑现风险。 7月零售销售环比意外下降0.6%，美债价格走强、纳指开盘指示强于道指；RDDT、NU、NVDA和INTC盘前价格反馈相对健康，AMAT虽业绩beat却盘前跌逾6%而仅列风险观察。今晚可验证盘后大型科技财报样本不足。

entries.summary_en: US equities stayed firm after cooler PPI, while Futunn Sparks showed Data Storage, AI Application Software, WallStreetBets, ETH-holding companies and EV Charging leading. But JD.com fell despite a beat and high-expectation technology names such as Cisco and Coherent were sold, so A/H focus is Lenovo AI infrastructure, JD platform support, CPO/storage mapping and high-multiple fade risk.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东航运与油价尾险仍限制风险偏好
公开市场报道显示，红海、霍尔木兹和中东安全议题仍影响能源安全溢价；即便隔夜油价回落，A/H仍需把中海油、中国石油、油服和航运成本作为科技高估值的对冲变量。
国际
美国PPI降温后美股创新高，利率压力阶段缓和
8月13日美股在PPI低于预期后走强，S&P 500和小盘股刷新高，10年期美债与油价回落；这对恒生科技和A股成长开盘有利，但不是无差别追高信号。
科技
Sparks正数Top5显示存储和AI应用领涨
Futunn Sparks显示存储概念+6.37%（SNDK +13.67%）、AI应用软件+4.31%（WDAY +17.78%）、WSB热门+4.08%（FFAI +22.51%）、以太坊储备+3.00%（FGNX +8.43%）、充电桩+2.82%（EVGO +4.43%）；A/H映射优先看存储、AI软件、数据中心电源和新能源车链。
科技
Sandisk长期指引带动存储链，A股存储弹性优先
公开报道显示Sandisk因2030年前收入和利润率指引强劲上涨约14%，Micron也上涨；这强化AI服务器存储、HBM、模组和国产存储替代预期，映射兆易创新、澜起科技、佰维存储等。
科技
Workday并购预期拉动软件，但A/H应用端需看成交扩散
Workday因潜在并购消息上涨约18%，并带动部分软件股；不过软件行情更偏事件驱动，A股AI应用、办公软件和港股云服务需要开盘成交确认，不能直接等同于AI硬件主线。
科技
Applied Materials beat后盘后回落，半导体设备高位有筛选
Applied Materials财报超预期并给出较强指引，但盘后仍回落约2.5%；叠加Cisco、Coherent、Cerebras等高预期科技股被卖，A/H半导体设备和CPO如果高开无量，应防止卖事实。
财报
联想AI基础设施需求强，港股硬件链获得本地验证
HKEX业绩日历显示联想集团8月13日披露季度业绩，WSJ报道联想股价因AI基础设施需求和创纪录收入大涨约20%；这对港股硬件、服务器、PC和AI终端链是直接正反馈。
财报
京东二季度beat但ADR下跌，平台互联网看承接而非追高
Barron's报道JD.com二季度收入约3464亿元、非GAAP净利约89亿元，均好于预期，但ADR仍下跌约7.3%；9618.HK今日若不能修复，平台互联网和恒生科技权重可能被业绩卖事实压制。
财报
A/H财报检查以联想和京东为核心，Futu子项受限已降级
本机Futu OpenD 127.0.0.1:11111拒绝连接，HK/SH/SZ earnings calendar与NOTICE搜索受限；公开HKEX日历确认8月13日联想、港铁、新秀丽等业绩，JD.com也于8月13日披露，不使用纯美股公司财报补位。

盘前结论

今日A/H的正反馈来自两条线：PPI降温后的风险修复，以及Sparks里存储、AI应用软件、充电桩等高弹性主题领涨。但JD.com beat后ADR下跌、AMAT beat后盘后回落、Cisco/Coherent/Cerebras被卖，说明高预期科技股仍在被严格筛选。

港股重点看联想和京东：联想AI基础设施需求强，可支持硬件链；京东若低开后不能承接，会压制平台互联网和恒生科技。

Futu OpenD未启动导致本机A/H财报日历和公告搜索受限，已按规则降级；盘中需继续核对HKEX及交易所公告，避免把美股财报当作A/H财报结果。

重点个股推荐

联想集团
0992.HK
AI硬件

推荐理由：AI基础设施需求和创纪录收入带来港股本地正反馈，能把隔夜AI硬件映射落到港股权重。

触发因素：HKEX日历显示8月13日披露业绩，公开报道显示股价因AI基础设施需求大涨约20%。

风险点：若高开后成交不能维持，AI硬件利好可能被快速兑现。

京东集团
9618.HK
承接验证

推荐理由：二季度收入和非GAAP利润beat，但ADR下跌，今天港股价格反应是平台互联网关键验证。

触发因素：收入约3464亿元、非GAAP净利约89亿元均超预期；若9618.HK低开后修复，可改善HSTECH情绪。

风险点：若市场更关注补贴、外卖投入和利润率压力，beat可能继续被卖。

兆易创新
603986.SH
存储映射

推荐理由：Sparks存储概念领涨，Sandisk强指引和Micron上涨提升A股存储链开盘弹性。

触发因素：SNDK +13.67%，存储概念+6.37%，AI服务器存储需求继续被交易。

风险点：若存储价格和订单没有后续验证，板块容易从映射上涨转为短线兑现。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO验证

推荐理由：AI服务器和数据中心链仍是A股对美股科技最直接映射，CPO可受存储与AI硬件共同情绪支撑。

触发因素：存储、AI应用和数据中心电源同向，市场仍围绕AI资本开支寻找硬件兑现。

风险点：Coherent被卖提示光通信高预期风险，若高开缩量应避免追涨。

宁德时代
300750.SZ
充电链观察

推荐理由：Sparks充电桩和新能源车链走强，可为A股新能源权重提供补涨观察窗口。

触发因素：充电桩+2.82%、EVGO +4.43%，新能源车主题在风险偏好修复中获得边际关注。

风险点：映射强度弱于存储和AI硬件，若锂电成交不足，应只作观察不追高。

板块轮动看板

受益方向存储芯片、AI服务器、CPO光通信、港股AI硬件、数据中心电源、充电桩。
观察方向京东与平台互联网、AI应用软件、WSB/加密情绪、港股云服务。
压力方向半导体设备高预期、光通信高位、网络设备、可选消费、beat后下跌的中概电商。
验证信号0992.HK和9618.HK开盘承接、存储/CPO龙头成交额、恒生科技相对恒指强弱、离岸人民币和油价亚洲盘。

逻辑链

美国PPI降温、油价和美债回落，先给A/H成长和港股科技一个偏正面的开盘环境。
Futunn Sparks显示存储和AI应用领涨，隔夜美股强分支映射到A股存储、CPO、服务器和港股AI硬件。
联想业绩和股价正反馈提供本地验证，但京东beat后ADR下跌提醒平台互联网不能只看利润超预期。
AMAT、Cisco、Coherent等高预期科技股回落，说明半导体和光通信高位需要成交确认，否则容易卖事实。
若联想、京东、存储和CPO同时承接，恒生科技和A股科技可延续修复；若只有Sparks映射高开，资金会转向能源防御和低估值方向。

风险雷达

京东卖事实

若9618.HK跟随ADR下跌，平台互联网可能压制恒生科技。

半导体高预期

AMAT beat后回落、Cisco和Coherent被卖，提示设备和光通信高位兑现风险。

Sparks映射过短

WSB、以太坊储备等领涨更多代表风险偏好，A/H基本面映射较弱。

中东能源尾险

油价回落缓和通胀，但航运和霍尔木兹风险反复会重新压制成长股估值。

Futu子项受限

OpenD端口拒绝连接，A/H公告日历需盘中继续核验交易所公告。

entries.html_en:
Major News
Macro
Middle East shipping and oil tail risk still restrain risk appetite
Public market reports show Red Sea, Hormuz and broader Middle East security issues still affecting the energy-security premium. Even with oil lower overnight, A/H should keep CNOOC, PetroChina, oil services and shipping costs as hedges against high-multiple technology risk.
Macro
US stocks hit highs after cooler PPI as rate pressure eased
On August 13, US stocks strengthened after softer-than-expected PPI, with the S&P 500 and small caps reaching highs while the 10-year Treasury and oil pulled back. This helps HSTECH and A-share growth at the open, but it is not a signal to chase everything indiscriminately.
Technology
Sparks positive Top5 shows storage and AI applications leading
Futunn Sparks showed Data Storage +6.37% (SNDK +13.67%), AI Application Software +4.31% (WDAY +17.78%), WallStreetBets +4.08% (FFAI +22.51%), ETH-holding companies +3.00% (FGNX +8.43%), and EV Charging +2.82% (EVGO +4.43%). A/H mapping should prioritize storage, AI software, data-center power and EV chains.
Technology
Sandisk guidance lifted the storage chain, giving A-share storage the first mapping
Public reports said Sandisk rose about 14% after giving strong revenue and margin targets through 2030, while Micron also gained. This reinforces expectations for AI-server storage, HBM, modules and domestic memory substitution, mapping to GigaDevice, Montage Technology and Biwin Storage.
Technology
Workday's deal speculation lifted software, but A/H applications need turnover confirmation
Workday rose about 18% on potential takeover speculation and pulled some software peers higher. Still, the software move is more event-driven, so A-share AI applications, office software and Hong Kong cloud services need opening turnover confirmation and should not be treated the same as AI hardware.
Technology
Applied Materials beat then faded after hours, so semiconductor equipment faces a high bar
Applied Materials beat fiscal-quarter expectations and guided solidly, but still slipped about 2.5% after hours. Together with selling in Cisco, Coherent and Cerebras, this says A/H semiconductor equipment and CPO names should avoid sell-the-news risk if they gap up without volume.
Earnings
Lenovo AI infrastructure demand gives Hong Kong hardware a local validation point
The HKEX earnings calendar showed Lenovo reporting on August 13, and WSJ reported Lenovo shares jumping about 20% on AI infrastructure demand and record revenue. That is direct positive feedback for Hong Kong hardware, servers, PCs and AI-device chains.
Earnings
JD beat Q2 estimates but ADRs fell, so platform internet must prove support
Barron's reported JD.com Q2 revenue of about RMB346.4 billion and non-GAAP net income of about RMB8.9 billion, both above expectations, yet ADRs still fell about 7.3%. If 9618.HK cannot recover today, platform internet and HSTECH weights may be pressured by sell-the-news earnings feedback.
Earnings
A/H earnings check centers on Lenovo and JD; Futu child checks degraded
Local Futu OpenD rejected 127.0.0.1:11111, so HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar and NOTICE searches were limited. Public HKEX calendars confirm August 13 reports from Lenovo, MTR, Samsonite and others, while JD.com also reported on August 13. Pure US-company earnings are not used as A/H substitutes.

Pre-Open View

Today's A/H positive feedback comes from two lines: risk repair after cooler PPI, and high-beta Sparks themes such as storage, AI application software and EV charging leading.But JD.com fell after a beat, AMAT faded after a beat, and Cisco, Coherent and Cerebras were sold, showing that high-expectation technology is still being screened hard.

Hong Kong focus is Lenovo and JD: Lenovo's AI infrastructure demand can support the hardware chain, while JD failing to find support after a weak open would weigh on platform internet and HSTECH.

Local A/H earnings-calendar and announcement searches were limited because Futu OpenD was not running; this was degraded under the rules, and exchange announcements still need intraday checks so US-company earnings are not treated as A/H results.

Key Assets

S&P 500
New-high support
10Y Treasury
Pressure eased
Data Storage

AI Software
Event driven
JD ADR

Oil

Keyword Cloud

Data Storage Lenovo AI Infra JD Beat-Fade AI Software High-Bar Chips CPO Optics Cooler PPI EV Charging Risk Appetite Energy Tail Futu Limited Consumer Drag
BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage move.

Focus Stocks

Lenovo Group
0992.HK
AI Hardware

Rationale: AI infrastructure demand and record revenue give Hong Kong a local positive-feedback point and translate overnight AI hardware mapping into a H-share weight.

Trigger: The HKEX calendar showed August 13 results, and public reports said the stock rose about 20% on AI infrastructure demand.

Risk: If a gap-up cannot hold turnover, the AI hardware benefit may be quickly monetized.

JD.com
9618.HK
Support Test

Rationale: Q2 revenue and non-GAAP profit beat expectations, but the ADR fell, making today's Hong Kong price reaction the key platform-internet test.

Trigger: Revenue of about RMB346.4 billion and non-GAAP net income of about RMB8.9 billion beat expectations; if 9618.HK recovers after a weak open, HSTECH sentiment can improve.

Risk: If investors focus on subsidies, food-delivery investment and margin pressure, the beat may keep being sold.

GigaDevice
603986.SH
Storage Mapping

Rationale: Sparks Data Storage led gains, and Sandisk's strong guide plus Micron's rise improve opening beta for A-share memory names.

Trigger: SNDK +13.67%, Data Storage +6.37%, and continued trading in AI-server storage demand.

Risk: Without follow-through in memory prices and orders, the sector can turn from mapping strength into short-term profit-taking.

Zhongji Innolight
300308.SZ
CPO Check

Rationale: AI servers and data-center links remain the most direct A-share mapping to US technology, and CPO can be supported by both storage and AI hardware sentiment.

Trigger: Storage, AI applications and data-center power moved in the same direction as investors keep looking for hardware realization in AI capex.

Risk: Coherent selling warns that optical-link expectations are high; avoid chasing a low-volume gap-up.

CATL
300750.SZ
Charging Watch

Rationale: Sparks EV Charging and EV chains strengthened, offering an observation window for A-share new-energy weights.

Trigger: EV Charging +2.82% and EVGO +4.43% show marginal attention to the theme during risk repair.

Risk: The mapping is weaker than storage and AI hardware; if lithium-battery turnover is insufficient, keep it as a watch item rather than chasing.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesMemory chips, AI servers, CPO optics, Hong Kong AI hardware, data-center power and EV charging.
WatchJD and platform internet, AI application software, WSB/crypto sentiment and Hong Kong cloud services.
PressureHigh-expectation semiconductor equipment, elevated optical links, networking equipment, consumer discretionary and China e-commerce that falls after a beat.
SignalsOpening support in 0992.HK and 9618.HK, turnover in storage/CPO leaders, HSTECH relative to HSI, offshore yuan and Asia-session oil.

Logic Chain

Cooler US PPI plus lower oil and Treasury yields first create a constructive opening setup for A/H growth and Hong Kong technology.
Futunn Sparks shows storage and AI applications leading, mapping the strongest US branches into A-share memory, CPO, servers and Hong Kong AI hardware.
Lenovo's results and share-price feedback provide local validation, but JD's ADR drop after a beat warns that platform internet cannot rely only on an earnings beat.
AMAT, Cisco and Coherent fading shows that semiconductor and optical-link leaders need turnover confirmation or they risk sell-the-news pressure.
If Lenovo, JD, storage and CPO all find support, HSTECH and A-share technology can extend the repair; if only Sparks mapping gaps higher, capital may rotate to energy defense and lower-valuation areas.

Risk Radar

JD sell-the-news

If 9618.HK follows the ADR lower, platform internet may weigh on HSTECH.

High-bar semiconductors

AMAT faded after a beat while Cisco and Coherent were sold, warning of equipment and optical-link profit-taking.

Short-lived Sparks mapping

WSB and ETH-reserve strength mainly reflects risk appetite, with weaker A/H fundamental mapping.

Middle East energy tail

Lower oil helps inflation, but renewed shipping or Hormuz risk would again pressure growth-stock valuations.

Futu child checks limited

OpenD refused the local port, so A/H announcement calendars need continued exchange checks intraday.

Sources and Timestamp

entries.title: 美股盘前：零售销售意外转弱，科技强于道指但AMAT遭负反馈
entries.summary: 7月零售销售环比意外下降0.6%，美债价格走强、纳指开盘指示强于道指；RDDT、NU、NVDA和INTC盘前价格反馈相对健康，AMAT虽业绩beat却盘前跌逾6%而仅列风险观察。今晚可验证盘后大型科技财报样本不足。
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
7月零售销售环比意外下降0.6%
美国商务部数据经AP报道显示，7月零售销售环比下降0.6%，明显弱于市场原先预期的小幅增长，并创2025年5月以来最大降幅；6月数据修正为增长0.2%。
消费
剔除加油站和汽车后零售销售仍下降0.2%
消费电子和线上零售支出回落，餐饮销售则增长0.5%；这更像商品消费降温而非服务消费全面失速，但会压制零售与可选消费的开盘情绪。
指数
数据后纳指开盘指示强于道指
9:00 ET附近的公开期指公平值读数显示，标普500指向小幅高开、道指约低开64点、纳指约高开92点；低利率敏感科技暂时受益，但指数分化意味着开盘后仍会震荡。
通胀
PPI降温曾推动标普创历史新高
周四标普500上涨0.7%并创纪录，纳指上涨0.8%；7月PPI同比由6月5.5%降至4.7%，让市场降低近端加息担忧，今天的弱零售数据进一步支持债券。
商品
霍尔木兹袭击消息令油价反弹
AP盘前数据显示，WTI原油上涨近1%至约81.83美元，布伦特升至约87.31美元；两艘阿联酋油轮遇袭使能源通胀尾险重新抬头，抵消部分利率利好。
财报
Applied Materials (AMAT) beat后盘前跌逾6%
AMAT公布约91.2亿美元收入和约3.50美元调整后EPS，均高于市场预期，且下一季指引偏强；但Nasdaq 9:04 ET报价仍跌约6.3%，反映此前涨幅和高预期兑现压力，因此只作风险观察。
指数事件
Reddit (RDDT) 将加入标普500，盘前涨逾11%

Major News
Macro
July retail sales unexpectedly fell 0.6% month on month
Commerce Department data reported by AP showed July retail sales falling 0.6%, far below expectations for a small increase and the largest decline since May 2025; June was revised to a 0.2% gain.
Consumer
Retail sales excluding gasoline and autos still fell 0.2%
Spending at electronics and online retailers declined, while restaurant sales rose 0.5%; this looks more like goods-consumption cooling than a broad services collapse, but it pressures retail and discretionary sentiment at the open.
Indexes
Nasdaq's implied open is stronger than the Dow after the data
Public fair-value readings near 9:00 ET pointed to a mildly higher S&P 500 open, a roughly 64-point lower Dow open, and a roughly 92-point higher Nasdaq open; rate-sensitive technology benefits for now, but index divergence still implies opening volatility.
Inflation
Cooler PPI had already pushed the S&P 500 to a record
The S&P 500 rose 0.7% to a record Thursday and the Nasdaq gained 0.8%; July PPI slowed to 4.7% year on year from 5.5% in June, reducing near-term hike fears, while today's weak retail data adds support for bonds.
Commodities
Hormuz attack headlines are lifting crude again
AP premarket data showed WTI up nearly 1% to about $81.83 and Brent near $87.31; attacks on two UAE tankers raised the energy-inflation tail again, offsetting part of the rates relief.
Earnings
Applied Materials (AMAT) is down more than 6% premarket despite a beat
AMAT posted about $9.12 billion revenue and roughly $3.50 adjusted EPS, both above expectations, with a firm next-quarter outlook; yet Nasdaq still showed a roughly 6.3% decline at 9:04 ET, signaling profit-taking and a very high earnings bar, so it belongs only in risk watch.
Index Event
Reddit (RDDT) will join the S&P 500 and is up more than 11% premarket
S&P Dow Jones Indices said RDDT will enter the S&P 500 before the August 18 open; Nasdaq showed about $175.79, up 11.18%, at 9:05 ET on roughly 0.91 million premarket shares, confirming event-driven demand.
Fintech
Nu Holdings (NU) is up about 14% premarket after earnings
Nasdaq showed NU near $15.88, up 14.00%, at 9:05 ET on roughly 9.04 million premarket shares; the price-and-volume response is much stronger than the market, making fintech one of today's clearest earnings-strength themes.
AI
NVIDIA (NVDA) and Intel (INTC) retain positive premarket feedback
Nasdaq data at 9:05 ET showed NVDA up about 0.31% on roughly 1.35 million shares and INTC up about 0.93% on roughly 2.12 million shares; both are holding better than AMAT, supporting a shift from equipment earnings into profitable large-cap AI and chip weights.
Calendar
Verifiable large-cap technology earnings after the close are insufficient tonight
Briefing.com and Kiplinger's weekly calendar show no large technology company after the August 14 close; other public calendars list only small or lightly covered names such as HIVE, NUAI, HSDT and SHAZ, without enough consensus, revision and historical-surprise data.

Pre-Market View

Treasury prices are rising and Nasdaq's implied open is stronger than the Dow, temporarily supporting profitable long-duration technology.But July retail sales unexpectedly fell 0.6%, showing a sharp cooling in goods demand and pressuring the Dow plus discretionary names at the open.

AMAT beat earnings and issued a firm outlook but is still down more than 6%, so it belongs in risk and pressure watch, not a long recommendation.Price feedback comes first: RDDT, NU, NVDA and INTC all have positive premarket support.

The base case is “technology relatively stronger but indexes choppy”: if the 10-year yield keeps falling and RDDT/NU hold their gaps, selective tech can extend; if oil surges or AMAT's sell-the-news reaction spreads, rotate toward defense and cash flow.

Logic Chain

The retail-sales miss weakens growth expectations but also lifts Treasuries, initially helping longer-duration technology stocks.
Oil is rebounding on Hormuz attacks, making the rates relief less clean while consumer and Dow names face both growth and energy-cost pressure.
RDDT, NU, NVDA and INTC have positive price-volume feedback; AMAT is plunging despite a beat, so capital prefers events, earnings quality and price confirmation.
If Nasdaq and Treasuries keep strengthening, selective technology can stay favored after the open; if oil and AMAT weakness spread, rotate toward defense and cash flow.

If markets read -0.6% as recession risk rather than rates relief, technology's stronger implied open can reverse quickly.

WTI is back near $81.83 and up almost 1%; further attacks would lift inflation expectations and pressure consumption.

AMAT's high-bar penalty spreads

AMAT is down more than 6% despite a beat; failure to stabilize could spread sell-the-news pressure into equipment, memory and AI capex.

Event gaps fade

RDDT and NU both have double-digit gaps; without continued volume support, index or earnings gains can fade quickly.
